question: Who is the author of the book ‘My Dateless Diary’, which is based on the interactions with Americans?
solution: The correct answer is __**R.K. Narayan**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • **R.K. Narayan** is the author of the book **‘My Dateless Diary’**, which was first published in **1960**. • The book is an **autobiographical travelogue** that recounts his experiences and **interactions with Americans** during his visit to the **United States** in **1956**. • Narayan traveled to **America** on a **Rockefeller Foundation** fellowship, and the book serves as a collection of his daily observations and musings without specific dates, hence the title **‘Dateless Diary’**. • The narrative provides a humorous and gentle critique of **mid-20th century American culture**, covering various aspects like food habits, social customs, and the intellectual environment of the time. • It captures his meetings with several notable figures and common citizens, showcasing his signature style of **irony** and **keen observation** of human nature.
